title: Operation Nutcracker
description: When an antique nutcracker set to be auctioned at the Warby family Christmas charity goes missing, a demanding event planner and the heir to the Warby dynasty try to track it down.

title: The Secret Gifts of Christmas
description: Personal shopper Bonnie helps a widowed man reconnect with his young daughter. Though their ideas of shopping couldn't be more different, she's determined to get them everything on their wish list.

title: Merry Memories
description: Michaela helps her nephew create a Christmas Scrapbook for his mom serving overseas by teaming with his teacher Bryan. Their unexpected romance proves love can be the greatest homecoming of all.

title: The 5-Year Christmas Party
description: Told over the course of five years, two recent college grads find themselves drawn together year after year while working for a catering company that specializes in holiday parties.

title: Christmas at the Golden Dragon
description: When Romy and Rick's parents surprise them with news that they'll be closing their decades-old Chinese restaurant, the siblings soon find themselves reevaluating their futures.

title: Next Stop, Christmas
description: Angie wonders what life would be like if she had married an ex who became famous. When she finds herself magically transported into the past, Angie has the chance to relive that Christmas and learn what (and who) is truly important to her.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
description: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.

description: Three brothers get the surprise of their lives when they are forced to work together and care for a baby over the holidays.
